story.title: An independent engine consultancy, founded in Zug
paragraphs: Flight Hour Solution is an independent jet-engine management consultancy, founded in Zug in 2024 and owned by its managing director.

The statutes were adopted on 4 September 2024. The company was entered in the commercial register of the canton of Zug on 26 September 2024 as a GmbH with a share capital of CHF 20,000. Since July 2025 it has been wholly owned by its managing director, Hubert Nowosad, who holds all 200 shares.

The registered purpose is plain: consulting services, technical expertise, training and knowledge transfer, cost optimisation and financial planning in the aviation industry. In practice that means jet-engine shop visit management, workscope compilation and review, contract negotiation, maintenance reserve calculations and records audits for airlines, lessors, MROs and government operators.

Two lines of work run under one name. Advisory is independent engine management consulting: shop visit management, workscopes, lease returns, contracts, data and records. Assets is engine and aircraft sourcing, sales support and listings. The two are kept apart and labelled, as the independence section below sets out.
The firm is small and led by its managing director. Table inspections and test-cell runs are attended in person. Between site visits the work is done from Zug, a short drive from Zurich Airport.

independence.title: Independence, in writing
independence.statement: Flight Hour Solution is owned by its managing director, not by an MRO, lessor or OEM. Advisory work is done for the client alone.
policy: Two lines, always labelled. Advisory is independent engine management consulting. Assets is engine and aircraft sourcing, sales support and listings. Every proposal, report and invoice names the line it belongs to.
On advisory work we act for the client alone. We take instructions from, report to and answer to the client who engages us, not to the MRO, the OEM or the counterparty to the lease or sale.
When we broker, market or source an engine or aircraft, we say so in writing before that asset is discussed.

An advisory client is never offered an asset we own or are marketing without written disclosure of our interest. Any such transaction runs under the Assets line, with its own engagement letter, and never as part of an advisory engagement.
If an Assets mandate and an advisory engagement touch the same engine, aircraft or counterparty, every client concerned is told before we continue, and may decline either.
independence.source: Ownership: docs/research/01-company-profile.md section 2 (Hubert Nowosad, a natural person, sole shareholder with 200 shares since July 2025; SOGC; Moneyhouse lists him as the only active member of management). Two labelled lines and the conflicts policy: docs/research/07-recommendations-and-brief.md section 2.3 option 1 ('when we broker an asset we say so; advisory clients are never sold our own inventory without disclosure') and section 2.2 (independence pillar). Independence as positioning: docs/research/06-market-context-and-seo.md section 5.1 item 3 and section 1.10 (no OEM, MRO, lessor or national-champion ownership; neutral ground for multi-party disputes); docs/research/05-competitor-benchmark.md section 5 item 2.
